items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: We call every once in a while, you know call them up, and Milt, he wants to play.

ctx.x: I’m happy to say. We call every once in a while, you know call them up, and Milt, he wants to play. Physically I don’t think he has the energy yet. He may have now, who knows?
Well you’re part of “The Trio” which —
